name: getOauthAccessToken
description: Gets an OAuth access token, like the `cfoauth` tag. Takes a struct of the settings that `cfoauth` accepts as attributes.

params.name: input
params.description: A struct of OAuth settings. It needs either `type` or both `authendpoint` and `accesstokenendpoint`, as in `cfoauth`.

coldfusion.notes: Listed by getFunctionList() in ColdFusion 2025+. No official documentation exists. The argument name and the struct requirement were confirmed on CF2025.
